proposals.current_spec: The actor service thread MUST be pinned to a core in the same NUMA zone as the NVMe controller device.
proposals.current_code: Branch revision used `cpus().iter().nth(2)` for the fallback core, which returns None on a NUMA node with <=2 cores and left the actor UNPINNED (violates the MUST). Fixed: `.nth(2).or_else(|| first core)`.
proposals.proposed: Code fixed; FR-013 now documents set_actor_cpu precedence and the third-core / first-core fallback.
